verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Global Accounts for receiving bank transfers through local payment methods and/or SWIFT from customers and platforms. It also documents accounts with local bank details that collect in 60+ markets, and multi-currency holding in 20 currencies. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and an explicit currency/market list tied to Global Accounts themselves (the 60+ markets and 20 currencies figures come from the Banking-as-a-Service overview).
